The [[Tibranese]] language was written with a set of '''hieroglyphics'''. As a memory of their old history, when simple [[hieroglyphics]] were the only things that could be written on soft objects in their environment, the Ishi Tib kept this old graphic script for millennia.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
